candidates.claim: The CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 is the first matching entry and permits tcp/502 from 192.168.30.102 to OT host 10.10.10.21, and CORP_IN is bound to the corp interface at fw-01:103, so corporate IT can open a connection directly into OT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01:60 permit from CORP_IN so that corporate traffic to OT is denied, unless the flow is formally approved and routed through the DMZ.

candidates.claim: The effective CORP_IN permit at fw-01:60 allows tcp/502 from CORP host 192.168.30.102 into the OT side, which is not one of the approved cross-zone services (A1 to A7).
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01:60 permit so that all CORP to OT traffic is mediated only by approved DMZ services.

candidates.claim: The baseline-delta record reports the access-list CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 as added relative to the approved baseline, and this change is not reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 against the approved baseline: revert it, or document an approved change.
